Functional description

The main beam headlamps activation signal is sent to pin 33 of connector B of the Body Computer

M1

from the steering column switch unit

H5

.

The 'ignition ON' signal (INT) for the switch H1 reaches the underdashboard control unit

B2

at pin 11 of connector H and from there moves on to the Body Computer

M1

(pin 9 of connector F).

The Body Computer

M1 controls the supply to the main beam headlamps by sending an earth signal to the engine compartment control unit B1B from pin 9 of connector A of M1 which energizes the relay T2: this supplies the dipped headlamps F10 (left) and F11 (right).

The circuit is protected by fuse F2 of the junction unit

B1A.
